blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Anti-narcotics operatives arrested three individuals in separate buy-bust operations here on Tuesday, seizing suspected shabu with an estimated street value of at least P218,000. The first operation was conducted at around 1:48 p.m. in Purok 3, Barangay Lumbo, netting two suspects identified as alias “Edwin,” 36, a driver from Barangay Bayabason, Maramag; and alias “Renalyn,” 46, jobless, from Purok 2B, Barangay Kinura, Kalilangan. Authorities recovered suspected shabu with an estimated street drug price of P176,120 from the duo.
